comment: Optically full on P/E; EV multiples materially below branded-component peers once cash is stripped.
Persistent EV/EBIT discount to Festo and Parker-Hannifin despite superior margins — a governance and capital-structure discount.
The ~¥2.5tn KDDI holding approaches the entire market cap; the core business carries a negative implied EV.
Headline multiples inflated by depressed earnings; on normalised mid-cycle EBIT the multiple is roughly half.
Sub-book with 35% of market cap in net cash — the market is explicitly pricing continued value destruction.
A pure-play watch business would command a materially higher multiple; conglomerate drag is explicit and quantifiable.
Cheapest EV multiples in the screen — EV is a small residual after stripping cash.
Retains a quality premium the margin trajectory no longer supports; the EV discount to global connector peers is masked by cash.
Deep-value multiples reflecting a genuine margin deficit rather than pure neglect.
Adjusted for the Yamaha Motor cross-holding, the core instruments business trades at a substantial discount to branded-consumer comparables.
Sub-1x book with assets at decades-old cost; the discount to realisable NAV is far wider than headline PBR.
Reported PBR is near-meaningless — prime Tokyo and Yokohama land at historic cost. True NAV discount is substantially wider.
High headline multiples on collapsed earnings; on any normalised margin the equity is deeply discounted.
Among the cheapest EV/EBIT multiples in Japanese retail, driven by net cash near 38% of market cap.
Sub-book with hidden Kyoto real estate and a listed securities portfolio; the operating business is barely profitable.
Assess on sum-of-the-parts, not earnings multiples. Listed securities ~¥800bn+ (Recruit, Tokyo Electron) exceed market cap.
Persistent EV/EBIT discount to Capcom despite arguably stronger IP — an execution and disclosure discount.
Wide EV/EBIT discount to global patient-monitoring peers (Masimo, Drägerwerk) despite a strong domestic installed base.
Sub-book despite a large investment property portfolio and listed securities worth a substantial fraction of market cap.
Widest discount to book in the screen, and the largest gap between reported book value and any realistic sum-of-the-parts.
